name: Life Timeline
tagline: A biography in flat-vector scenes: a new colour wipes in per milestone, springy shapes, and a year bar that advances along the bottom.
description: Flat-vector look: a new solid colour wipes in for every beat, a huge number and a short bold headline sit beside a springy illustration built from circles, rectangles and simple people, and a thin progress bar can advance along the bottom. The preview tells one person's life milestone by milestone.

display.usage: Year at 250px with -0.04em tracking, headlines 84px, line-height 1.02, max three lines

body.usage: Captions 38px at 500, AGE pill and bar labels 24–34px at 700 with 0.16em tracking

transitions: solid background colour wipes in from the right in 0.42s, led by a darker band 0.08s ahead
the previous scene is hidden only after the wipe covers it
progress marker travels to the next point in the same 0.6s while an arc draws behind it
textAnimations: big number rises 80px with expo.out, 0.45s, 0.3s after the wipe starts
label pill slides in from the left with back.out(2)
headline then caption rise 40px then 24px, staggered 0.12s
illustration parts pop from scale 0.15 at the base (transform-origin 50% 100%) with back.out(1.8), 0.06s stagger

rhythm.notes: Black opener 0.9s, then five milestones of ~1.15s, then a 2.3s closing quote card. Every scene: wipe, text cascade, illustration spring, then one small secondary motion (a plane sliding, a chart line drawing, a ticket swaying).

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Each beat gets its own solid colour field: cream #f3e8cd, mustard #eab43a, sage #a8c69f, coral #f07d66, sky #80c4ea, charcoal #2a2d33; black #0b0b0c for openers. Flat fills only.
- Transition by wipe: a darker band leads, then the next colour, x 1920→0 in 0.42s power3.inOut; keep the old scene underneath until the wipe finishes. Never crossfade.
- Layout: text column on the left (a huge number or year in Bricolage Grotesque 800 ~250px, an outlined label pill in DM Sans 700 34px with 0.16em tracking, an 84px headline of at most three lines, one 38px caption), one flat illustration on the right (~840×780).
- Illustrate the subject from circles, rects and simple paths, no strokes except tiny details; people are a head circle, rounded torso, two leg bars and line arms.
- Motion is springy: illustration parts pop from scale 0.15 at their base (transform-origin 50% 100%) with back.out(1.8), 0.06s stagger; the big number rises 80px with expo.out 0.3s after the wipe starts; headline then caption rise 40px then 24px.
- Optional motif: a thin progress bar along the bottom (4px line, ticks, a circle marker and linking arcs) that advances in the same 0.6s as each wipe.
- Keep beats short (~1.15s) and copy specific: numbers, counts, headlines under six words. Avoid gradients, shadows and photo textures.
example: The preview is a biography: one person's milestones by year, each on a new colour with an age label and a flat illustration, along a year bar, ending on a quote card. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
